required_invocation.stdin: closed (DEVNULL); an open stdin pipe blocks before the first model call
required_invocation.dir_flag: --dir <workspace>; relative tool paths otherwise resolve against the inherited PWD, not the process cwd

observed_behaviour.denied_tools: removed from the tool list sent to the model; a call to them yields tool_use status=error
observed_behaviour.rate_limit: retries internally, then emits one error event (statusCode 429, retry-after header) and exits 1
observed_behaviour.title_request: one extra tool-less completion per new session (small model) for the session title

opencode_cli.provenance: Recorded 2026-11-11 by running the installed 1.19.5 binary against tests/fakes/api_server.py in an isolated XDG home; no real model account used.
